credit_line: Given in honor of Elizabeth Mabel Holthues Stanley by her family
description: A white lotus flower, seen from its side, begins to open its petals. Its center and twisting stamens are bright yellow. A green stem supports the bloom, which contrasts with the pale blue background behind it.
title: White Lotus
